name: mnemonic_sonic_desaturation
label: Mnemonic Sonic Desaturation
godotFeature: Godot 4.6.2 Audio Bus system with dynamic AudioEffect manipulation (e.g., EQ, PitchShift, Volume), AudioStreamPlayer for layered playback, and dynamic crossfading/mixing of AudioStream assets.
poeticVision: Feel the very fabric of sound dissolve and fray as Lyra's identity erodes. Key melodic lines, rhythmic anchors, or specific environmental frequencies that once defined a coherent soundscape will individually desaturate, fragment, or vanish entirely. Each sonic loss is a chilling echo of a forgotten truth, a piece of Lyra's self that has dissolved. When a memory is recovered, a specific musical motif or a lost environmental sound snaps back, creating a fleeting, poignant moment of sonic wholeness amidst the chaos, only for the threat of desaturation to return. The player doesn't just hear distortion, but the *absence* of specific sonic memories.
usage: Attach this script to a global autoload singleton (e.g., 'AudioManager') or any persistent Node in your scene. Configure your Godot Project Settings -> Audio -> Buses to include the bus names specified in 'memory_audio_states' (e.g., 'Music_Layer_A', 'SFX_Memory_Echo'). Each of these custom buses MUST have an 'AudioEffectEQ' added as its first effect (index 0). Your game's AudioStreamPlayer nodes should output to these specific buses. To trigger a memory desaturation, call 'AudioManager.desaturate_memory("childhood_melody")'. To restore it, call 'AudioManager.restore_memory("childhood_melody")'. The script will smoothly interpolate the volume and EQ gain of the associated audio bus, creating the effect of sonic desaturation or restoration.

parameters.name: transition_speed_db_per_sec
parameters.description: The speed (in dB per second) at which audio bus volume transitions between states.

parameters.name: transition_speed_eq_per_sec
parameters.description: The speed (in dB per second) at which the EQ band gain transitions between states.

verdict: A symphony of self-loss, this invention masterfully weaves the unraveling of identity into the very soundscape, making silence a chilling echo of a forgotten soul.
impact: This will profoundly deepen the player's emotional connection to Lyra's struggle, transforming the abstract concept of memory loss into a visceral, auditory experience where the very fabric of the world's soundscape reflects her eroding identity, making every recovered memory a poignant sonic return.
